title: Update Loft floor plant
notes: User request: improve the rudimentary random ovals / bubbles used as plant life throughout Sparks & Machines. Keep it simple. Coordinated foliage-only revision across the selected room plants, street planters, trees, window boxes and vines: tapered folded leaves, connected sprigs and small five-petal flower heads. Preserve pots, buildings, supports, authored finishes, fruit/vegetable displays, robot models, placement/collision, the approved boy and camera. Deliver all revised model IDs together for review.

The octagon has a face toward each compass point and diagonal; the pressure gauge faces south-east, toward the game camera (notice board south, maintenance door east, service panel north-west). Parts that story may move later are separate nodes with their pivots (story_parts): the needle turns about its local Z (-27 degrees per unit of pressure in Godot, authored at 1.3), the door swings about its hinge (local Y), the valve wheels spin about their axles.
